tile_text: Angular constructivist head and shoulder profiles
Sharp geometry and vibrant color fields

page_copy.pattern: Constructivist portrait language uses sharp angles, clear silhouettes, and bold color fields that stay legible across scales.
page_copy.action: A generative pass established profile geometry and axis lines, then in painting refined edge discipline, color relationships, and highlight placement.
page_copy.measured: Delivers cohesive geometric portraits that read instantly in tiles and carry enough structure for print, social showcases, and provenance linked digital editions.
